breakdowns.translation_en: His mother was someone who worked in that household.

parts.explanation_en: His mother is the topic; the rest of the sentence describes her role.
That household is the place where she worked.
Modifies the following 사람: 'who works.' Here it describes her work at the time of the past statement, so English uses 'who worked.'
Means 'was a person.' Together with the preceding modifier, this identifies her as someone who worked in that household.

breakdowns.sentence: 그래서 아버지는 길동이 아버지를 “아버지”라고 부르지 못하게 했습니다.
breakdowns.translation_en: So his father prevented Gildong from calling him “Father.”

parts.explanation_en: Means 'so,' connecting this restriction to the preceding explanation of his mother's status.
His father is the topic and the person who imposes the restriction.
Gildong is the subject of the embedded action: he is the person who would use the title.
His father is the person addressed, and “아버지” is the exact title, 'Father,' that Gildong would use.
부르지 못하다 means 'cannot call'; adding -게 하다 means making that inability happen. In this past-tense context, the complete phrase means 'prevented him from calling him that.'
